title: 思考越多，偏见越深：推理模型中的长度驱动位置偏见
summary: 研究发现，在推理模型中，思维链推理轨迹的长度与多项选择题中的位置偏见正相关。轨迹越长，模型越倾向于选择位置偏好的选项。截断干预实验提供了因果证据。尽管大模型（671B）的总体偏见较小，但长度效应仍在最长四分位数中显现。
summary_en: Research reveals that in reasoning models, chain-of-thought trajectory length positively correlates with position bias in multiple-choice QA. Longer trajectories increase preference for position-favored options. Truncation intervention provides causal evidence. While aggregate bias is small in large models (671B), length effect persists in the longest quartile.
